name: Alarm
description: Cast while preparing rest. The party cannot be surprised during that unfinished rest. Wandering monster chance during rest is halved, or quartered on a natural 20.
paragraphs: Cast while preparing rest. The party cannot be surprised during that unfinished rest. Wandering monster chance during rest is halved, or quartered on a natural 20.

name: Burning Hands
description:
You spread your fingers with thumbs touching, unleashing a circle of flame that roars out to a close area around where you stand.

Creatures within the area of effect take 1d6 damage, and flammable objects catch fire.
paragraphs: You spread your fingers with thumbs touching, unleashing a circle of flame that roars out to a close area around where you stand.
Creatures within the area of effect take 1d6 damage, and flammable objects catch fire.

damage.context: Creatures within the area of effect take 1d6 damage, and flammable objects catch fire.

name: Charm Person
description:
You magically beguile one humanoid of level 2 or less within near range, who regards you as a friend for the duration.

The spell ends if you or your allies do anything to hurt it that it notices.

The target knows you magically enchanted it after the spell ends.
paragraphs: You magically beguile one humanoid of level 2 or less within near range, who regards you as a friend for the duration.
The spell ends if you or your allies do anything to hurt it that it notices.
The target knows you magically enchanted it after the spell ends.

name: Cure Wounds
description:
Your touch restores ebbing life.

Roll a number of d6s equal to 1 + half your level (rounded down).

One target you touch regains that many hit points.
paragraphs: Your touch restores ebbing life.
Roll a number of d6s equal to 1 + half your level (rounded down).
One target you touch regains that many hit points.

name: Detect Magic
description: You can sense the presence of magic within near range for the spell's duration. If you focus for two rounds, you discern its general properties. Full barriers block this spell.
paragraphs: You can sense the presence of magic within near range for the spell's duration. If you focus for two rounds, you discern its general properties. Full barriers block this spell.

name: Feather Fall
description:
You may make an attempt to cast this spell when you fall.

Your rate of descent slows so that you land safely on your feet.
paragraphs: You may make an attempt to cast this spell when you fall.
Your rate of descent slows so that you land safely on your feet.

name: Floating Disc
description: A Floating Disc joins the party if a slot is available, counting toward the maximum of 16. It has 20 gear slots and can equip only lanterns. It cannot move independently or block creatures. It stays still during combat, then follows its caster even through darkness. It lasts one hour of game time, including rest. It vanishes if its caster is dying or dead, dropping its contents. A natural 20 offers two discs or a two-hour duration.
paragraphs: A Floating Disc joins the party if a slot is available, counting toward the maximum of 16. It has 20 gear slots and can equip only lanterns. It cannot move independently or block creatures. It stays still during combat, then follows its caster even through darkness. It lasts one hour of game time, including rest. It vanishes if its caster is dying or dead, dropping its contents. A natural 20 offers two discs or a two-hour duration.

name: Hold Portal
description: You magically hold a portal closed for the duration. A creature must make a successful STR check vs. your spellcasting check to open the portal. The knock spell ends this spell.
paragraphs: You magically hold a portal closed for the duration. A creature must make a successful STR check vs. your spellcasting check to open the portal. The knock spell ends this spell.

name: Holy Weapon
description:
One weapon you touch is imbued with a sacred blessing.

The weapon becomes magical and has +1 to attack and damage rolls for the duration.
paragraphs: One weapon you touch is imbued with a sacred blessing.
The weapon becomes magical and has +1 to attack and damage rolls for the duration.

name: Light
description: One object you touch glows with bright, heatless light, illuminating out to a near distance for 1 hour of real time.
paragraphs: One object you touch glows with bright, heatless light, illuminating out to a near distance for 1 hour of real time.

name: Mage Armor
description: An invisible layer of magical force protects your vitals. Your armor class becomes 14 (18 on a critical spellcasting check) for the spell's duration.
paragraphs: An invisible layer of magical force protects your vitals. Your armor class becomes 14 (18 on a critical spellcasting check) for the spell's duration.

name: Magic Missile
description:
You have advantage on your check to cast this spell.

A glowing bolt of force streaks from your open hand, dealing 1d4 damage to one target.
paragraphs: You have advantage on your check to cast this spell.
A glowing bolt of force streaks from your open hand, dealing 1d4 damage to one target.

damage.context: A glowing bolt of force streaks from your open hand, dealing 1d4 damage to one target.

name: Shield Of Faith
description: A protective force wrought of your holy conviction surrounds you. You gain a +2 bonus to your armor class for the duration.
paragraphs: A protective force wrought of your holy conviction surrounds you. You gain a +2 bonus to your armor class for the duration.

name: Sleep
description:
Living creatures of level 2 or less in a 7 by 7 square centered on the caster fall asleep. The caster is immune; eligible allies are affected. Walls and closed doors block the effect. Sleeping creatures are prone, cannot move or act, and have no line of sight. Injury or an adjacent creature spending an action wakes them.

A natural 20 offers level 4 or less, or a 13 by 13 square.
paragraphs: Living creatures of level 2 or less within a 7 by 7 square centered on the caster fall asleep. The caster is immune; eligible allies are affected. Walls and closed doors block the effect.
Sleeping creatures are prone, cannot act or move, and have no line of sight. Injury or an adjacent creature spending an action wakes them. Standing afterward costs half their movement.
A natural 20 offers level 4 or less, or a 13 by 13 square.

name: Protection from Evil
description: While you maintain focus, a protective aura surrounds you. Chaotic beings within it have disadvantage on attacks and spellcasting; you are exempt. Creatures within the aura cannot be charmed, beguiled, possessed, compelled, or mind-controlled. A chaotic priest instead casts Protection from Good, affecting lawful and neutral beings. A critical success doubles the aura to 10 feet.
paragraphs: Maintain focus with a free spellcasting check each subsequent round, and immediately after damage or a distracting effect. An ordinary failed focus check ends the aura without losing the spell. A natural 1 applies normal critical failure rules.

name: Turn Undead
description:
You rebuke undead creatures, forcing them to flee. You must present a holy symbol to cast this spell.

Undead creatures within near of you must make a CHA check vs. your spellcasting check. If a creature fails by 10+ points and is equal to or less than your level, it is destroyed. Otherwise, on a fail, it flees from you for 5 rounds.
paragraphs: You rebuke undead creatures, forcing them to flee. You must present a holy symbol to cast this spell.
